description.value: The Sutton Place Hotel is a full-service luxury hotel located in downtown Vancouver's Burrard Street corridor, offering room tiers ranging from standard Sutton Rooms to multi-bedroom suites with soaker tubs and wet bars. The property features an indoor heated pool, Vida Spa, a dedicated wine merchant, and the on-site Boulevard Kitchen & Oyster Bar. Touring cyclists would find a full concierge, onsite laundry, and free Wi-Fi throughout the property, though no cycling-specific facilities are advertised.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 63m; stands (2 spaces) at 65m; stands (4 spaces) at 73m; stands (2 spaces) at 75m; stands (2 spaces) at 94m; stands (3 spaces) at 95m. Total: 15 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website provides detailed room listings and a full amenities page but makes no mention of bike storage, bicycle handling procedures, or any cycling-specific facilities anywhere. Wi-Fi and onsite laundry are explicitly confirmed via the amenities page and room descriptions. The two required WWC criteria (secure bike storage and staff bike procedure knowledge) cannot be confirmed from any available evidence, making this a needs_review candidate.
concerns: No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, e-bike charging, bike tools, bike wash) are mentioned anywhere on the website.

OSM phone (+1-866-378-8866) is a toll-free reservations line; a local number (604.682.8432) appears only on the Vida Spa subpage and may be spa-specific — main hotel phone could not be confirmed from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, operating luxury hotel in downtown Vancouver, but neither the website nor OSM tags provide any evidence of secure bike storage or staff familiarity with cycling needs — both required WWC criteria. A direct inquiry to the hotel is needed before a listing can be included.

Laundry.detail: Amenities page explicitly lists 'Onsite laundry' and 'Same day dry cleaning'
